text:
sam: FYI — Prospect Alejandra from VelvetCo asked if we can onboard an open model `koi-7b` into Private (VPC) for EU + LATAM, and pin a quantized variant for lower cost. Wants SLA for 99th pctl latency < 700ms for short prompts.
alejandra: confirming — goal is chat assistant in Spanish/Portuguese, peak 300 qps, sustained ~50 qps. Data must stay in their VPC EU region + Chile/BR latency best-effort.
maya: thanks. quick triage: this touches catalog onboarding (new upstream model), private deployment (VPC network + KMS), quant/compat, and geo availability for LATAM. Also export controls? Lina, any red flags?
lina: initial check: koi-7b license is permissive (MIT-ish) but upstream includes a transformer arch with some custom ops. Need model artifact audit + licenses. No export-control flags from repo metadata, but confirm training data provenance.
jin: engineering: we need a wheels-up action on runtime support for koi custom ops. If not compatible, we can offer a compiled/converted variant or FP16 quant path. Also need to validate CSR for quantized FP8 path on our runtime.
ravi: from SE side: customer wants a pinned model name + version API param so they won't break on upgrades. Also they want canary rollout inside their VPC and a fallback to hosted variant if private capacity degraded.
frank: onboarding queue note — we need the model tarball + provenance + preferred quant recipe. Can we ask VelvetCo to provide the exact git commit or release tarball? Also need sample prompts for eval.
sam: Alejandra can provide a release hash by EOD and a small prompt corpus. SLA negotiation: they're open to commit for Dedicated capacity but prefer Private VPC if possible.
maya: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- model artifacts validated and stored in catalog in EU region
- quantized variant (8-bit/4-bit) that runs with SLO under our private runtime
- pinned API + canary rollout in their VPC
- security review completed, KMS integration verified
- cost estimate and Dedicated commit options if private capacity needed
lina: add: threat modeling + provenance signoff before GA.
jin: blocker list:
- runtime kernel missing for custom op (engineer ETA 7d)
- quant recipe may need tuning for spanish tokenizer differences (ETA variable)
- infra for LATAM egress/peering — ops to estimate network path
ravi: ask to product: prioritization — does this land as medium priority backlog item or enterprise track? Customer is a paying pilot but not yet enterprise contract.
maya: propose enterprise track (pilot -> paid Dedicated) but start with a scoped spike: compatibility + small pilot (2 weeks) to validate perf. If spike passes, escalate to Dedicated onboarding lane.rank: spike checklist (2 weeks):
- run conversion tests on koi release hash
- quantize with our internal recipe(s) and run perf microbenchmarks
- deploy a canary in customer VPC with 10 rps, collect latency/cost
- security signoff request created
alejandra: that plan works for VelvetCo. will provide artifacts and corpora today. timeline: can start pilot next week.
sam: ok — I'll capture customer commitment. Maya, can you slot spike in next sprint? if yes, we'll inform Alejandra of dates.
maya: slotting now. I'll create intake ticket with the acceptance criteria and assign to Jin + Frank + Lina. ETA for spike start: 2168001720 (next Tue). 
jin: got it — will prioritize kernel audit first.
frank: creating onboarding ticket and adding required checklist items. tagging @onboarding-bot :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks all — I'll update roadmap board and flag potential Dedicated upsell if pilot perf looks good. Alejandra, ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
